what.title: What is MindGold?
what.text: MindGold is a self-hosted learning platform that combines three modes: study, play, and create. Whether you're learning a language, a programming language, or any other subject — MindGold adapts to your needs.

cheatsheet.title: CheatSheet — Learn
cheatsheet.text: Read through structured questions, correct answers, and explanations. Perfect for deep understanding and revision.

game.title: Game Arena — Test
game.text: Play quizzes against the clock. Get instant feedback, earn points, and climb the leaderboard.

editor.title: Quiz Lab — Create
editor.text: Build your own quizzes manually or generate them with AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini). Import ready-made JSON in seconds.

how.title: How to Use
how.step1: Create a quiz in Quiz Lab — manually or with AI assistance.
how.step2: Study it in CheatSheet — read the questions, answers, and explanations.
how.step3: Play it in Game Arena — test your knowledge against the clock.
how.step4: Repeat the cycle — deepen your understanding over time.

languages.title: Any Subject, Any Language
languages.languages: Languages: German B1, English C1, Ukrainian, ...
languages.note: The interface is available in EN / DE / UK. Quiz content can be in any language — just specify it in the AI prompt (e.g. "Language: Spanish"). The prompt templates support EN / DE / UK by default.

why.title: Why MindGold?
why.feature1: ✅ AI-powered creation — generate quizzes in seconds.
why.feature2: ✅ Structured learning — organized by topics and tags.
why.feature3: ✅ Progress tracking — see your improvement over time.
why.feature5: ✅ Multi-language — interface available in EN / DE / UK.
